main_text.head: REGIO IV.
main_text.p: Via sacra, alias Templum Pacis. Victor, Rufus. Meminit Quarta Regionis Ara Marmorea, quæ in domo Hieronymi Pici, ad Campum Floræ, male habita.

page.notes: Left margin note: "IV. Via Sacra". Right margin numbers 10, 20, 30, 40, 50 are line numbers.
